title: Return
category: interest and other financial claims need a matching fact
owner_function: SEBI advertisement code for mutual funds and ASCI Code Chapter I (no assured returns)

title: Regulator or bank endorsement claims need evidence
source_ref: Kora Compliance Policy 4.2 (no implied regulator endorsement)

title: Rankings and superlatives need a source
params: {"regex": "(?i)\\b(india'?s (no\\.? ?1|number one|best|fastest|most trusted|safest)|#1|best in india|fastest in india)\\b"}
source_ref: ASCI Code Chapter I (substantiation of superlatives)

title: Security claims must be specific
No promises of loan approval
params: {"words": ["instant approval", "guaranteed approval", "no credit check", "100% approval", "approved in seconds"], "case_sensitive": false}
source_ref: RBI digital lending directions (fair practices) and ASCI Code Chapter I

title: Investment mentions need the market-risk disclaimer
params: {"when_regex": "(?i)\\b(mutual funds?|invest(ing|ment|ments)?|SIP|equity|stocks?)\\b", "must_regex": "(?i)subject to market risks?", "message": "Add: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks, read all scheme related documents carefully."}
source_ref: SEBI mutual fund advertisement code (standard risk warning)

title: Credit offers must state the APR
params: {"when_regex": "(?i)\\b(loans?|credit line|EMI|borrow(ing)?)\\b", "must_regex": "(?i)\\b(APR|annuali[sz]ed percentage rate)\\b", "message": "State the APR (and any processing fee) wherever a loan or credit line is offered."}
source_ref: RBI digital lending directions (key fact statement and all-in cost)

title: Interest rates need 'p.a.'
params: {"when_regex": "(?i)\\b\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\s?%\\s?(interest|returns?)\\b|\\binterest\\b[^.]{0,40}\\b\\d+(\\.\\d+)?\\s?%", "must_regex": "(?i)(p\\.a\\.|per annum|per year)", "message": "Quote interest as a yearly rate: say 'p.a.' and 'rates may change'."}

title: Cashback, referral and reward offers need T&Cs
params: {"when_regex": "(?i)\\b(cashback|referral|bonus|rewards?|\\d+\\s?% off|offer)\\b", "must_regex": "(?i)\\bT&Cs? apply\\b", "message": "Offers must say 'T&Cs apply' and link to the terms."}

title: Savings wording needs the partner-bank statement
params: {"when_regex": "(?i)\\b(savings account|bank account|deposits?)\\b", "must_regex": "(?i)(partner bank|not a bank|banking services are provided)", "message": "Say that Kora is not a bank and that banking services are provided by the partner bank."}
source_ref: RBI guidance on fintech and bank partnerships (clear disclosure of the regulated entity)

title: Paid or gifted creator posts must disclose the partnership
params: {"when_regex": "(?i)\\b(gifted|sponsored|in partnership with|collab|paid partnership)\\b", "must_regex": "(?i)(#ad\\b|#sponsored\\b|\\bpaid partnership\\b)", "message": "Add #ad or 'Paid partnership' at the start of the caption."}
source_ref: ASCI guidelines for influencer advertising in digital media (2021)

title: Never mention unreleased product names
Text in images meets WCAG contrast (4.5:1; 3:1 for large text)
Every non-decorative image has alt text written by a person
Tone is calm and plain, never fear or urgency about money
params: {"instruction": "Flag sentences that use fear, urgency pressure or fear of missing out about money, or that talk down to the reader. Calm, clear and friendly is fine."}
examples_good: Move money in seconds, with no fees.|Your savings, earning every day.
examples_bad: Don't be left behind: everyone is getting rich with this!|Act now or lose out.

title: At most one exclamation mark
Avoid all-caps words (brand name and standard acronyms excepted)
Write amounts with the ₹ symbol, not Rs. or INR
Every post has one clear call to action
params: {"when_regex": "[^\\s.!?][^.!?\\n]*", "must_regex": "(?i)\\b(download|open|start|try|send|save|invest|apply|get|join)\\b", "message": "Add one clear call to action, for example 'Download Kora'.", "scope": "copy"}
